characters.name: Anna
characters.want: to know if he still remembers

characters.name: Tomas
characters.want: to say what he never said

story_parse.central_action: Two former lovers meet by chance on the last ferry of the night.
fixed_events: They meet again on the last ferry of the night.

beats.summary: Anna rides the empty ferry alone.
beats.genre_effect: Her want shows in what she does not do.
beats.style_effect: Wet rails, the engine's hum, real cold.

beats.summary: Tomas sits down across from her.
beats.genre_effect: They talk about the weather and mean the past.
beats.style_effect: Tangible objects: a paper cup, a scarf.

beats.summary: She leaves the scarf on the bench for him.

screenplay.title: The Last Ferry
screenplay.logline: On the last ferry of the night, a woman meets the man she once loved and has one crossing to decide what to leave behind.

scenes.purpose: Bring the two of them face to face.
scenes.change: Anna is no longer alone with her memory.

elements.text: Rows of empty benches. ANNA (70s), a wool scarf wound twice, holds a paper cup she does not drink.
TOMAS (70s), a cane hooked over his arm, stops in the aisle. He sits across from her.
The engine shudders. Their knees almost touch.

scenes.purpose: Let Anna choose what to give back.
scenes.change: Anna leaves something of herself with Tomas.

elements.text: Cold wind. The pier lights grow closer. Anna and Tomas stand at the rail.
I should have come to the station that day.
I waited until the last train. Then I stopped waiting.
The ferry bumps the pier. Anna unwinds her scarf and lays it on the rail beside his hand.
She walks down the ramp without looking back.

added_assumptions.text: The lovers are named Anna and Tomas.
They parted because Tomas did not come to the station.
added_assumptions.reason: The story does not say why they parted.

added_assumptions.text: Anna leaves her scarf behind as the ending.
